svg.title: Cancer-associated Fibroblast — Matrix context
svg.desc: A fibroblast in tumor-associated context, shown alone or with surrounding extracellular matrix. CAF populations are heterogeneous. Shape, fibers and matrix do not identify a CAF subtype or a universal marker; add model-specific labels and evidence.
